transcript.speaker: employee
transcript.text: ACME Support, this is Priya. How can I help?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: I reset my password an hour ago and now the app says my account is locked. I have a client call in twenty minutes.

transcript.speaker: employee
transcript.text: That sounds stressful with a call coming up, so let's get you back in quickly. Can you confirm the email on the account and the last four digits of the phone number?

transcript.speaker: customer

transcript.text: Thanks, that matches. Three failed sign-ins after the reset triggered a security lock. I've cleared it, and I'm sending a one-time code to the phone ending 4417.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Got the code and I'm in. Thank you!

instructions.task: Did the employee restate or summarise the customer's problem back to them in their own words?
instructions.guidance: Judge only the employee's turns in the supplied transcript.

criteria.true: The employee played the problem back, confirmed their understanding, or summarised the situation for the customer to confirm.
criteria.false: The employee moved straight to questions, instructions, or a fix without reflecting the problem back.

instructions.task: What is the customer's predominant emotional state in the most recent part of the call?
instructions.guidance: Weigh the customer's latest turns most heavily; judge the customer, never the employee.

criteria.frustrated: Annoyed or exasperated with the employee, the product, or having to repeat themselves.
criteria.anxious: Worried about consequences, under time pressure, or uneasy about risk.
criteria.skeptical: Doubting what the employee has told them, or pressing for proof of a claim.
criteria.cooperative: Engaged and working the problem with the employee, without notable distress.
criteria.reassured: Calm and confident the issue is handled or in good hands.
criteria.neutral: Matter-of-fact exchange with no clear emotional colour.
